riley_sec: Heads-up: scheduling pen-test retest Thu 2026-06-03 09:30-12:30 PT. Need RBAC snapshot, KMS decrypt via proxy (no key export), and an immutable audit bundle. Who can own pieces?

sam_infra: I can own the KMS proxy and key-policy changes. Need freeze window for infra changes 07:00-13:00 PT.

maya_ops: I'll do the audit export: S3 Object Lock Governance 90d, manifest+sha256, and CloudTrail filter for KMS/ST S/ S3/IAM changes. Also produce presigned manifest link post-export.

leo_sre: Traces: enable full APM sampling for 09:15-12:45 PT and snapshot prometheus histograms + cache metrics. Confirm TSDB quota before full dump.

eva_research: For assessor access, prefer CI-approved STS tokens (TTL=7200). Proxy should accept bearer token, log request_id, caller_arn, key_id, and return plaintext over TLS. No direct key ARNs to assessors.

riley_sec: Action list: @sam_infra deploy proxy + set key rotation hold; @maya_ops author runbook + dry-run; @leo_sre enable sampling + snapshot plan; @eva_research prepare CLI snippets and signing step.

maya_ops: Scheduling dry-run Tue 6/1 09:00 PT. RSVP here.

auditbot: Ticket PT-6122 created and assigned.
